latest.title: Rough differential equations on manifolds via natural bundles
latest.abstract: In the article, a novel framework for rough differential equations on finite-dimensional smooth manifolds driven by branched rough paths is developed utilizing the theory of natural bundles. The role of vector fields is played by sections of certain associated fiber bundles. The solutions are defined in a generalized Davie sense via a local approximation in such a way that they are invariant under changes of coordinates. Existence and uniqueness of the solutions is proved and a necessary and sufficient condition for the invariance of a submanifold for the solution is given. The approach allows the treatment of rough differential equations driven by fully branched rough paths on manifolds without directly relying on a shuffle product formula, bracket extension, or the Connes-Kreimer Hopf algebra and without imposing additional structure on the manifold.
latest.workSummary: 用自然丛建立流形上由完全分支粗糙路径驱动的粗糙微分方程坐标不变框架。
latest.breakthrough: 无需 shuffle 公式、括号扩张或附加流形结构即可证明存在唯一性及子流形不变判据。
latest.limitations: 属于随机/粗糙分析基础工具，几何应用尚未在摘要中展开。
